article.story: CONWAY, S.C. -- — Robert Davis Jr. had 29 points in Old Dominion's 70-66 win over Coastal Carolina on Thursday. Davis shot 11 for 18, including 5 for 10 from beyond the arc for the Monarchs (5-12, 2/3 Sun Belt Conference). KC Shaw scored 12 points and added seven rebounds. Caelum Swanton-Rodger finished 5 of 7 from the floor to finish with 10 points. The Chanticleers (8-9, 1-4) were led in scoring by Josh Beadle, who finished with 18 points. Coastal Carolina also got 16 points from Reggie Hill. Rasheed Jones finished with 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
